platformReason: Part of the project's platform. Users and files are copied as parts of their own.
noLongerListed: SnoutData Cloud does not list that project any more.
betweenOnly: A copy goes between this computer and SnoutData Cloud.
nameNew: Give the new project a name.
sourceNoConn: "{sourceLabel}" has no saved connection for its database. Open its Database section to add one.
targetNoConn: "{targetLabel}" has no saved connection for its database. Open its Database section to add one.
findingsToDecide: The database has findings to decide below.
noSignIn: None: sign-in is off on the source
userExists: A user whose email is already on the target is left as it is.

usersNoEmail.one: {count} user without an email (anonymous, phone or deleted) stay behind.
usersNoEmail.other: {count} users without an email (anonymous, phone or deleted) stay behind.

passwordsAcross: Passwords come across as they are stored, so people sign in with the ones they have.
noStorage: None: storage is off on the source
bucketExists: A bucket or a file already on the target is left as it is.
noRoom: The files are {size} and "{targetLabel}" has room for {room} on its plan.
replaces: Replaces {list} on the target with this computer's version.
secretReplaced: A secret with the same name on the target is replaced. Values go from this computer to SnoutData Cloud and are never shown.
chooseOnePart: Choose at least one part to copy.
toolsMissing: The Postgres tools the database copy runs are not installed yet.
typeToConfirm: The target is a production project. Type "{confirmName}" to start the copy.
stoppedKept: Stopped. What was copied before that stays on the target.
waitingFor: Waiting for the target's {what} to start
madeNeedsLook: The new project was made, but its database needs a look before anything is copied into it: {first} Open the copy again to decide.

copiedBut.one: Copied, but {count} thing did not come across as it was. The details are below.
copiedBut.other: Copied, but {count} things did not come across as it was. The details are below.
